notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Following the recent release of the third game in the Blocks! collection, Hammer of the Scots, we have updated [b]Richard III[/b] with the improvements brought in the last product.

Those mostly concern improvements of the multiplayer engine.
Also, we have added improvements to the retreat procedures.

Work is going on, thanks to the current ongoing early access campaign, on the other engine features that are still in demand, and that will be ported back into this game when completed.

Visit the Hammer game here : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201310/Blocks_Hammer_of_the_Scots/]Hammer of the Scots Early Access[/url]

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
At the same time as the JC patch, some of the added feature on multiplayer has a minor patch here.

[MULTIPLAYER] Fix game occasionally stuck on Battle Retreat phase ("Retreat from Pool" message)

notes.title: New Blocks! game soon
notes.content:
[h1]The [b]Blocks! [/b]collection gets larger...[/h1]

[previewyoutube=GqEPX7hW0To;full][/previewyoutube]

Our partner [u]Columbia Games[/u] is presenting their second title ported on the Blocks! engine, [b]Julius Caesar[/b].

The real good news here, besides enlargment of the collection, is that with the success of this campaign we hope to get the [i][b]multiplayer function (exclusively on Steam)[/b][/i] to be working on the game.

And of course, Richard III players will benefit from it in the next major update on this game.

Thanks all for your support.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/columbiagames/blocks-julius-caesar?ref=user_menu]Caesar on Kickstarter[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1 + Spanish + Release deal ends in 48h!
notes.content:
After an overwhelming positive response since launch last week, we are pleased to announce the first patch for Richard III, including a few fixes (details below) and translation of the game into Spanish!

[b]Release offer ends very soon, make sure to grab your copy swiftly![/b]


[u]Patch Notes[/u]
[BUG/FREEZE] Fixed AI occasionally unable to play (leading to stuck game)
[BUG] Fixed blocks on map not reset to full strength when reloading a save after end of 1st campaign
[INPUT] Disable Joystick inputs moving camera
[RULE] Reset mercenaries to appropriate origin exile area instead of closest exile area
[RULE] York now starts as King in 1483 Campaign
[RULE] Add manual PDF access from Options menu
[BOARD] Card hand on map board is clickable to look into it during player turn
